name: Kairo
tagline: A shared workspace for small teams: issues, docs and projects, Linear meets Notion.
description: Kairo is a desktop workspace for a small team: issues and projects in the spirit of Linear, documents in the spirit of Notion, updated live for everyone. It ships through its own release pipeline, not through this tap.
installNote: Kairo is not distributed through Homebrew. See its site: https://saasempiree.github.io/kairo-site/
updateNote: Kairo updates itself through its own release pipeline.
